name.es: Encuadernador de patas de latón (broche mariposa), cabeza redonda
name.fr: Attache parisienne en laiton, tête ronde

description.en: A two-prong paper fastener: a round domed head on a split shank whose self-piercing point goes through stacked sheets and opens flat behind them. A single brad is the pivot of a sheet join (volvelles, rotating arms); it mates the stack's hole by its shank.
description.es: Un encuadernador de dos patas: una cabeza redonda abombada sobre un vástago partido cuya punta autoperforante atraviesa las hojas apiladas y se abre en plano por detrás. Un solo encuadernador es el pivote de una unión entre hojas (volvelles, brazos giratorios); se une al barreno de la pila por su vástago.
description.fr: Une attache parisienne à deux pattes : une tête ronde bombée sur une tige fendue dont la pointe autoperforante traverse les feuilles empilées et s'ouvre à plat derrière elles. Une seule attache sert de pivot à une liaison entre feuilles (volvelles, bras tournants) ; elle s'accouple au trou de la pile par sa tige.
description.pt: Um colchete de duas pernas: uma cabeça redonda abaulada sobre uma haste fendida cuja ponta autoperfurante atravessa as folhas empilhadas e se abre por trás. Um só colchete é o pivô de uma união entre folhas (volvelles, braços giratórios); acopla ao furo da pilha pela haste.

governing.designation: ACCO solid brass round head fastener (71505, 71507)

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the head's underside, on the shank's axis. +z runs along the split shank to its point at z = shank_length_mm; the head lies on the −z side. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the brad turns freely in a round hole, so the interface has continuous symmetry.

head_diameter.note: 15/32 in as listed for both sizes (source 1 too), × 25.4 (derived)

parameters.note: The cited sizes are 1-1/4 in (31.75) and 2 in (50.8); use one of those. The default, the shorter, is a catalog convention for a sheet pivot.

label.es: Vástago a través de las hojas

interfaces.note: Male: the shank enters the stack's hole and the head bears on the top sheet. The normal points along the shank toward the stack, as bhcs-m5x10's head seat. Symmetry 0: the brad is a pivot, free to turn (Pliego join 'pivot').

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (K3 lane, 2026-10-10); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: Neither listing gives the shank's width or thickness, the head's height or the hole a brad needs (its point pierces paper); they are not written, so the entry has no envelope. ACCO's brass-plated line lists a 0.38 in head on its 1 in size (a different part). The Spanish name varies by country: 'encuadernador' in Spain, 'broche mariposa' in parts of Latin America.
